title.justification: The title clearly states the paper's focus on revising hotel recognition datasets, which is central to the paper's content.
title.quote: We provide revisited versions of the Hotels-50K and Hotel-ID datasets for developing algorithms to counter human trafficking, namely Revisited Hotels-50K and Revisited Hotel-ID.

extractions.description: This paper proposes revised versions of the Hotels-50K and Hotel-ID datasets with the aim of better aligning with real-world applications such as countering human trafficking through improved dataset evaluation setups. The paper emphasizes the necessity of creating evaluation settings with truly unseen classes to mimic real-world challenges in human trafficking detection.

sustainable_development_is_central.justification: While the paper is significantly focused on a social issue—human trafficking—it does not primarily address climate or ecological sustainable development.
sustainable_development_is_central.quote: With the advance of advertisement technology and easy-to-use and low-risk online platforms, traffickers have been exploiting such platforms for recruiting victims, e.g. by posting fake recruitment ads, or soliciting buyers, e.g. by advertising their victims on online escort websites.

primary_category.justification: The paper primarily addresses the development of datasets to combat human trafficking using image recognition, which is not directly related to climate or ecological sustainable development as defined by the list.
primary_category.quote: In this paper, we propose revisited versions for two recent hotel recognition datasets: Hotels-50K and Hotel-ID. The revisited versions provide evaluation setups with different levels of difficulty to better align with the intended real-world application, i.e. countering human trafficking.

primary_sub_category.justification: There are no sub-categories within climate or ecological sustainable development that directly fit the focus of this paper on human trafficking and dataset revision.
primary_sub_category.quote: The main contributions of this paper are as follows: We provide revisited versions of the Hotels-50K and Hotel-ID datasets for developing algorithms to counter human trafficking.

new_primary_category.justification: The paper focuses on using revised datasets for addressing social issues, particularly human trafficking, which necessitates a different category beyond climate and ecological development.
new_primary_category.quote: Motivated by this, there has been a growing number of studies on developing data-driven algorithms for HT detection.

new_primary_sub_category.justification: The paper's revision of dataset evaluation setups is explicitly aimed at developing algorithms to counter human trafficking, indicating a need for a sub-category that covers social justice and protection operations.
new_primary_sub_category.quote: We provide revisited versions of the Hotels-50K and Hotel-ID datasets for developing algorithms to counter human trafficking, namely Revisited Hotels-50K and Revisited Hotel-ID.
